sets.title: J-source characters removed from the CJK D candidate
sets.scope: The 78 J-source characters that IRGN1250 asks to remove from the CJK D candidate, with the serial and source printed beside each glyph. The request leaves later resubmission open, and some of the characters were proposed again.

documents.title: Request to Remove 78 J-Source from CJK D candidate
documents.status: Asks the IRG to remove 78 J-source characters from the CJK D candidate for lack of evidence or unsettled shapes; some may return in a later extension proposal.

sets.label: Ext.D withdrawn · V

names.en: V-source characters withdrawn from CJK D

sets.title: V-source characters withdrawn from the CJK D candidate
sets.scope: The 107 V-source characters that IRGN1567 asks to withdraw from the CJK D candidate, one record per row. Each record keeps the d_v20 working number as its serial and the V-source id printed beside it. The second number in the same cell is a draft code point (ucs_tmp); neither printed number is claimed to be a published Unicode scalar. The request leaves later resubmission open.

documents.title: Request of withdrawing 107 glyphs in V-source Ext.D
documents.status: Asks IRG#32 to withdraw 107 V-source characters from CJK D. Rows print d_v20, a draft code point (ucs_tmp) and a V source; pages 2–15 also carry scanned evidence. No published scalar is claimed for any row.

sets.label: Ext.D withdrawn · G

names.en: G-source characters withdrawn from CJK D

sets.title: G-source characters proposed for withdrawal from the CJK D candidate
sets.scope: The 3,215 G-source characters that IRGN1531 asks to withdraw from the CJK D candidate, one record per row: the D V20 working number and the G source printed beside a glyph cut from the document's page. The numbers are proposal identifiers, and no published Unicode scalar is claimed for any row. The request leaves later resubmission open.

documents.title: Request of withdrawing 3,215 G-source CJK_D characters
documents.status: Asks IRG#31 to withdraw 3,215 G-source characters from CJK D because the evidence for them could not be collected in time. Pages 2–26 print six columns of glyphs, each beside a D V20 working number and a G source; the document itself prints only the draft number “IRG N xxxx”. A withdrawal request states no scalar for any row and is not a final disposition.

sets.label: Ext.D withdrawn · T

names.en: T-source characters withdrawn from CJK D

sets.title: T-source characters withdrawn from the CJK D candidate
sets.scope: The 6,545 T-source characters that IRGN1306 asks to withdraw from the CJK D candidate, one record per row. Each record keeps the C1_V20 working number as its serial, the printed row number as its sequence and the T source printed beside it. C1_V20 is a working number, and no published Unicode scalar is claimed for any row. Two rows repeat one working number and two pairs repeat a source, as printed.

documents.title: Request to Withdraw 6545 T-Source from CJK D candidate
documents.status: Asks the IRG to withdraw 6,545 T sources from the CJK D candidate, leaving 1,614. The cover prints “IRG N 1306” and the attachment headers “IRGN 1306 Attachment”; rows print only a row number, C1_V20 and a T source, with no glyph column. The cover says the attachment has 62 pages while its attachment pages run 1–61. Rows 3900 and 3901 repeat one working number and source, and TC-5229 and TD-4F5C each appear twice.
